description: ADSR envelope generator with a delay stage before the attack, and a self-gating hold mode

params.text: Sets how long after the gate opens the attack begins, up to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to rise from 0V to 10V, up to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from 10V to the sustain level, up to 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds for as long as the gate stays open, 0 to 100% of 10V
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from the sustain level to 0V once the gate closes, up to 10 seconds
Sets how long the internal gate stays open in TRIG mode, up to 10 seconds
Attack, decay and release are each switchable between linear, exponential and logarithmic
Holds the envelope open in GATE mode and starts a cycle in TRIG mode, on every polyphonic channel at once
GATE, where TRIGGER gates it as usual; or TRIG, where a trigger starts a cycle held open for the time set by HOLD
Times ten times slower; RETRIG — attack from the current level, or restart from the delay
ATT begins a new attack from the level the envelope has already reached; RST restarts the cycle from the delay stage

inputs.text: A gate runs the envelope in GATE mode and a trigger starts a cycle in TRIG mode; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony

outputs.text: A trigger when the release finishes

menu: Resume loop on load — an envelope that was looping when the patch was saved starts looping again when the patch is loaded
